questions.stem: When does menstruation begin in girls?
questions.solution: Menstruation begins at puberty, which is when the body starts developing secondary sexual characteristics. At birth, the body is not yet developed enough for this process. The other options refer to later stages of life, not the beginning of menstruation.

hi.stem: लड़कियों में मासिक धर्म कब शुरू होता है?
hi.solution: मासिक धर्म प्रारंभिक यौवन में शुरू होता है, जब शरीर द्वितीयक यौन लक्षणों के विकास की प्रक्रिया शुरू कर देता है। जन्म के समय शरीर इस प्रक्रिया के लिए पर्याप्त विकसित नहीं होता है। अन्य विकल्प जीवन के बाद के चरणों को संदर्भित करते हैं, न कि मासिक धर्म की शुरुआत को।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Hindi terminology for biological concepts.

mr.stem: मुलींमध्ये मासिक पाळी कधी सुरू होते?

questions.stem: What is the common name for the menstrual cycle?
questions.solution: The common name for the menstrual cycle is 'period' because it refers to the monthly shedding of the uterine lining. Menopause is the end of a woman's reproductive years, pregnancy is the state of carrying a developing fetus, and ovulation is the release of an egg from the ovary, none of which are the same as the menstrual cycle.

hi.stem: मासिक चक्र के लिए सामान्य नाम क्या है?
hi.solution: मासिक चक्र के लिए सामान्य नाम 'मासिक धर्म' है क्योंकि यह गर्भाशय के आवरण के मासिक झड़ने को संदर्भित करता है। मेनोपॉज महिला के जनन काल के अंत को संदर्भित करता है, गर्भावस्था एक विकसित भ्रूण के साथ ले जाने की स्थिति है, और अंडोत्सर्ग अंडाशय से अंडे के निकलने को संदर्भित करता है, जो कोई भी मासिक चक्र के बराबर नहीं है।
hi.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate Hindi terminology used for medical concepts.

mr.stem: मासिक चक्राचे सामान्य नाव काय आहे?

questions.stem: What is the primary reason for the changes that occur during adolescence?
choices: To prepare the body for reproduction
questions.solution: The primary reason for changes during adolescence is to prepare the body for reproduction, as hormonal changes drive the development of secondary sexual characteristics and reproductive systems. The other options describe specific physical changes that occur during this time but do not explain the overall purpose of adolescence.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a physical change observed in both boys and girls during adolescence?
choices: Growth of hair in the pubic region
questions.solution: The correct answer is the growth of hair in the pubic region, which occurs in both boys and girls during adolescence due to hormonal changes. Development of breasts is specific to girls, and growth of facial hair is typical in boys. Change in voice is also more common in boys, making it less universal than pubic hair growth.

questions.stem: What is the process called in which the body of a child undergoes observable and internal changes to develop into an adult capable of reproduction?
questions.solution: Puberty is the process during which a child's body undergoes both visible and internal changes that prepare it for adulthood and the ability to reproduce. Menstruation is a part of the female reproductive cycle, not the overall developmental process. Adolescence refers to the broader transitional period between childhood and adulthood, not specifically the biological changes of reproduction. Secondary sexual characteristics are physical traits that develop during puberty but are not the entire process itself.

hi.stem: बच्चे के शरीर में दृश्य एवं आंतरिक परिवर्तन होने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है जिससे वह वयस्क बनकर जनन क्षमता वाला हो जाता है?
hi.solution: शुक्रवीर्य वह प्रक्रिया है जिसमें बच्चे के शरीर में दृश्य एवं आंतरिक परिवर्तन होते हैं जो वयस्कता एवं जनन क्षमता के लिए तैयार करते हैं। मासिक चक्र महिला जनन चक्र का एक हिस्सा है, न कि समग्र विकास प्रक्रिया। किशोरावस्था बचपन एवं वयस्कता के बीच व्यापक संक्रमण काल को कहते हैं, जो जनन के जैविक परिवर्तनों के विशिष्ट रूप में नहीं है। द्वितीयक लैंगिक लक्षण शुक्रवीर्य के दौरान विकसित होने वाले शारीरिक लक्षण हैं लेकिन पूरी प्रक्रिया नहीं हैं।

questions.stem: If a student notices that their voice is changing and they are growing taller, which stage of life are they most likely experiencing?
questions.solution: Adolescence is the stage of life when the body undergoes significant changes, including growth spurts and voice changes due to hormonal shifts. These physical developments are characteristic of this period, which typically occurs during the teenage years. Infancy and childhood do not involve such dramatic physical changes, and old age is associated with the slowing down of bodily functions rather than growth.

hi.stem: यदि एक छात्र ध्यान देता है कि उनकी आवाज बदल रही है और वे लंबे हो रहे हैं, तो वे सबसे अधिक किस जीवन चरण में हो सकते हैं?

questions.stem: Why are secondary sexual characteristics considered natural signs of adolescence?
choices: Because they are the only changes that occur during adolescence
Because they help distinguish males from females
Because they are the main reason for reproduction
Because they are the same for all individuals
questions.solution: Secondary sexual characteristics help distinguish males from females by developing during adolescence, which is a key indicator of puberty. The other options are incorrect because these characteristics are not the only changes during adolescence, they are not the main reason for reproduction, and they vary among individuals.
